PARIS CELEBRATES THE TRIUMPHANT END OF THE WAR.

Paris held its great Peace March yesterday 14/7/19, not only to celebrate victory, but also to commemorate the removal from the world of its greatest menace.

Photo shows: - One of the illuminated buildings.
